decisions.quote: A national sample of psychology instructors (N ¼ 134) rated the appropriateness and frequency of 104 potential student behaviors, replicating and extending Parr and Valerius.
decisions.reason: The study collects new survey data from a national sample of psychology instructors to re-test and compare faculty ratings of student behaviors against Parr and Valerius (1999).

decisions.quote: A national sample of psychology instructors (N ¼ 134) rated the appropriateness and frequency of 104 potential student behaviors, replicating and extending Parr and Valerius.
decisions.reason: Both shipped and blind coding identify Parr and Valerius (1999) as the replicated target study.

decisions.quote: The top 10 ratings for appropriateness and frequency differed from previous work.
decisions.reason: The author explicitly concludes that the top 10 ratings for both appropriateness and frequency differed from and did not match Parr and Valerius (1999), and under the codebook partial item overlap counts (5 of 10 and 6 of 10) do not establish a mixed outcome.
